choices.text: Let them talk. People say more to a listener than to a question.
Nod, and keep your own counsel.

nodes.text: No, I slept, as I generally do when I am weary without having the courage to amuse myself, or when I am hungry without feeling inclined to eat.
But you can sleep when you please, monsieur?
Scarcely had Ali disappeared when the valet entered the chamber.

title: Haydée — after the Chamber stood up
